description_ru: Поездка на панорамном поезде через швейцарские Альпы.
text:
Some journeys are famous because they are fast. The Glacier Express in Switzerland is famous because it is slow. It takes about eight hours to travel less than three hundred kilometres, and that is exactly the point.

The train connects two mountain resorts, Zermatt and St. Moritz. During the trip, it crosses almost three hundred bridges and passes through ninety tunnels. The highest point of the route is the Oberalp Pass, which is more than two thousand metres above sea level. The carriages have huge windows that curve into the roof, so passengers can admire the peaks above them.

I made this journey last September. I sat next to the window, and I did not look at my phone once. We passed deep valleys, wooden villages and waterfalls that seemed to fall from the sky. In the dining car, a waiter served hot soup and fresh bread while the mountains slid slowly past.

A few practical tips: you must book your seat in advance, because the train is very popular. If you travel in summer, you will see green meadows, but winter offers snowy landscapes. Sit on the right side if you want the best views, and bring a warm jacket, because the windows can be cold.

If you ever have a free day in Switzerland, I strongly recommend this trip. It has taught me that the road is sometimes more beautiful than the destination.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы слегка касаются нижней губы, звук звонкий; не оглушайте его в «ф».
Округлите губы в трубочку и быстро раздвиньте их; зубы не касаются нижней губы, иначе получится «в».
Откройте рот шире, чем для русского «э», язык низко и впереди: звук между «э» и «а».
